docs.title: Tiri Dotfiles
docs.text: [![View Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/View-Documentation-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://wgparch.github.io/tiri/)     A highly customized Tiri window manager configuration with Waybar and Rofi on Arch Linux.

docs.title: ✨ Features
docs.text:
• Waybar Integration: Custom status bar with config1.jsonc and style1.css.
  • Rofi Theme: Beautiful "buscgirl" theme for application launcher.
  • Power Menu: Clean system actions menu with powermenu.sh.
  • Tiri Configuration: Optimized for keyboard-driven workflow.

docs.title: 📖 Documentation & Installation
docs.text: For full installation instructions, configuration details, and theming options, please visit the Official Documentation Website.

docs.title: 📸 Screenshots
docs.text: Visit the Gallery to see the setup in action!

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: This repository contains a highly customized Tiri window manager setup with Waybar and Rofi.

docs.title: Tiri Window Manager
docs.text:
• configs/tiri/config.kdl: Main Tiri configuration file.
  • configs/tiri/config.kdl_bak: Backup of the main configuration.

docs.title: Waybar Status Bar
docs.text:
• configs/waybar/config1.jsonc: Waybar configuration for Tiri (uses config1.jsonc).
  • configs/waybar/style1.css: Custom CSS styling for Waybar.

docs.title: Rofi & Power Menu
docs.text:
• configs/rofi/buscgirl.rasi: Custom Rofi theme configuration.
  • configs/rofi/powermenu.sh: Power menu script for system actions.

Note: The config.jsonc and style.css files in /etc/xdg/waybar/ are for SwayWM and are not part of this Tiri configuration.

docs.title: Theming
docs.text: This section covers the theming and visual customization of the Tiri window manager setup.

docs.title: Waybar Theme
docs.text:
The Waybar status bar uses a custom theme with the following files:

  • Configuration: \/etc\/xdg\/waybar\/config1.jsonc
  • Styling: \/etc\/xdg\/waybar\/style1.css

docs.title: Customization
docs.text:
To customize the Waybar appearance:

  1. Edit the CSS file: bash sudo nano /etc/xdg/waybar/style1.css

  2. Common customizations:

  3. Colors: Modify the background, color, and border-color properties
  4. Fonts: Change the font-family and font-size properties
  5. Spacing: Adjust padding and margin values

docs.title: Rofi Theme
docs.text:
The Rofi launcher uses a custom "buscgirl" theme:

  • Configuration: configs/rofi/buscgirl.rasi
  • Power Menu: configs/rofi/powermenu.sh

docs.title: Customization
docs.text:
To customize the Rofi appearance:

  1. Edit the theme file: bash nano ~/.config/tiri/rofi/buscgirl.rasi

  2. Common customizations:

  3. Background: Modify the background and background-color properties
  4. Text Color: Change the text-color and foreground properties
  5. Selection: Adjust the selected-normal-background and selected-normal-foreground properties

docs.title: Tiri Configuration
docs.text:
The main Tiri configuration file controls window behavior and appearance:

  • Configuration: configs/tiri/config.kdl

docs.title: Customization
docs.text:
To customize Tiri behavior:

  1. Edit the configuration file: bash nano ~/.config/tiri/config.kdl

  2. Common customizations:

  3. Window Gaps: Adjust the gaps setting
  4. Border Width: Modify the default-border-width setting
  5. Border Colors: Change the border-color and border-color-focused settings

docs.title: Color Scheme
docs.text:
The current setup uses a cyberpunk-inspired color palette with: - Primary accent colors for focused elements - Dark backgrounds for reduced eye strain - High contrast for readability

Feel free to modify these colors to match your personal preferences!
